point: Seadragon is a visual technology enabling smooth and continuous navigation through massive amounts of image and visual data.
quote: this is seadragon and it's an environment in which you can either locally or remotely interact with vast amounts of of visual data

point: System performance is bounded only by the physical display pixels on screen rather than the size or quantity of the source data.
quote: the only thing that that ought to limit the performance of a system like this one is the number of pixels on your screen

point: The architecture easily supports non-image and multi-scale media formats like complete books and digital newspapers.
quote: this really gives you the the the joy and the good experience of reading the real paper version of of a magazine or a newspaper

point: Embedding deep, high-resolution content directly into media eliminates screen real estate constraints and intrusive advertisements.
quote: this really gets at some of these ideas about really doing away with with those limits on on screen real estate

point: Photosynth merges Seadragon with computer vision algorithms to spatially map and register collections of photographs.
quote: the computer vision algorithms have registered these images together so that they correspond to the real space in which these these shots

point: Complete 3D architectural reconstructions can be generated automatically from unorganized photos sourced online.
quote: this is a reconstruction of notre dame cathedral that was done entirely computationally from images scraped from flickr

point: The system seamlessly integrates photographs taken from diverse devices, ranging from mobile phones to high-end cameras.
quote: this is lots of different types of cameras it's everything from cell phone cameras to professional slrs quite a large number of them

point: Connecting individual visual contributions creates an emergent collective model that far exceeds the sum of its individual parts.
quote: all of those photos become linked together and they make something emergent that's greater than the sum of the parts

point: User images automatically inherit descriptive metadata added by others who contributed to the shared space.
quote: their own photos are getting tagged with meta data that somebody else entered

point: Content-based visual hyperlinking drives massive semantic interconnection across disparate photos through network effects.
quote: it's creating hyperlinks if you will between between images and it's doing that based on the content inside the images
